text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It has appeared!! The future of our fortune-telling shop is...
'A grand reopening brings supreme good fortune'!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A grand reopening!?
Does that mean we're moving~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It'll be too tough with just the two of us.
Let's call for backup!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Moving time~, moving time♪ Hum-de-hum~♪
Let's make sure to clean the new place
all spick and span too~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You're such a lifesaver~, Tannhauser-san.
I'm so clumsy that unpacking wasn't going anywhere at all~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it at all!
I've been interested in fortune-telling shops for a while now anyway!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Besides, there are so many interesting things here~.
Where should I put this globe?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's the Globe of Happiness~.
Fukukitaru-master, where should this go~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
In the northern corner!
Grand Master Rickey told me that's the most
auspicious placement for it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Okey-doke, right over here. Little Globe-chan,
get along nicely with Little Crystal Ball-chan and the gang—whoa-whoa!
(Thud! Roll, roll...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah! Doto-chan!
Watch out, your feet! The globe is right under your feet~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Fueh? Hyowaaaaaaah!?
(Crash, smash, rumble!)

While walking across the plaza, a nearby shed
suddenly collapsed with a mighty crash!
If I recall correctly, that was supposed to be a student's fortune-telling shop—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: It was me! I'm the one who did ittttt!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all!
I was the one who messed up just now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! We're fine!
Not a single scratch on any of us!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha...
The fortune-telling shop completely collapsed, though.
Miraculously, we're all intact~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Miraculously? ...Gasp!
Could this be nothing less than the will of the Great Cosmos!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's a stern divine revelation telling us:
'You must reopen on a grand scale.
In other words, rebuild it completely from scratch!!' That has to be it!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I see, a warning from the gods...!
We can't just settle for something small and modest!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's rebuild it once more~!
This time, let's make sure it meets Great Cosmos-san's approval~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then let's rethink it right from the core concept!
We'll create a fortune-telling shop unlike any other—the greatest in the universe!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san!
What kind of fortune-telling shop should we make?
Give us some big ideas!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Altering destiny...!
How aggressive. It sounds like a battle-type fortune-telling shop.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's wonderful!
From now on, whenever we share a reading,
we'll make sure to provide a method to avoid misfortune as well!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: We'll be offering salvation to everyone then~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's psych ourselves up, everyone.
Towards the grand reopening of the 'Destiny-Altering Fortune-Telling Shop'~!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Ei! Ei! Mun!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Never misses!?
100% is a bit much, honestly... M-Maybe around 50% instead!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You can do it, you can do it!
If you round up, 50% is basically 100%!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The remaining 50% comes from pure spirit~!
Master can totally hit the mark!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Let's get fired up right away, everyone!
Towards the grand reopening of the 'Never-Misses Fortune-Telling Shop'!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Ei! Ei! Mun!!
